from tools import search_hotels, search_attractions, filter_attractions, filter_hotels, sort_results, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve previous attraction search results from cache
attractions_search = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Search for hotels in San Jose with the specified criteria
hotels_search = search_hotels(
    city="San Jose",
    checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
    checkout_date=["2025-08-11"],
    num_rooms=1,
    num_people=5,
    budget=115,
    stars=[4],
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Filter hotels based on the user's preferences
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels_search,
    budget=115,
    stars=[4],
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Sort hotels by price per night in ascending order
sorted_hotels = sort_results(
    results=filtered_hotels,
    column="price_per_night",
    ascending=True
)

# Save the hotel search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=sorted_hotels)

# Search for scenic attractions in San Jose
attractions_search = search_attractions(
    city="San Jose",
    type=["Scenic"]
)

# Filter attractions based on the user's preferences
filtered_attractions = filter_attractions(
    prior_results=attractions_search,
    type=["Scenic"]
)

# Save the attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=filtered_attractions)
